svg.title: Two rows of three small graphs showing a signal on a long journey. Top row, digital: the signal sent is clean rectangular pulses; after a long distance the pulses are smaller and covered in random wiggles of noise, but each one is still clearly high or low; after a regenerator the pulses are clean and full size again, exactly as sent. Bottom row, analogue: the signal sent is a smooth wave; after a long distance it is smaller and noisy; after an amplifier it is full size again, but the noise has been made bigger too, so the wiggles stay.
